educator_resources.title: Sanctuary Colors Interactive Lesson
educator_resources.desc: Hands-on lesson exploring the eight sacred colors and their biblical meanings. Students create color cards and match each color to its scriptural significance.
objectives: Connect colors to Bible stories and Christ's ministry

educator_resources.title: Build a Tabernacle Model
educator_resources.desc: Group activity to construct a proportional scale model of the wilderness tabernacle using simple materials. Emphasizes exact biblical dimensions and arrangement.
objectives: Understand the spatial relationship of components

educator_resources.title: Investigative Judgment Presentation
educator_resources.desc: Comprehensive presentation on the doctrine of the investigative judgment, covering Daniel 7 and 8, the 2300-day prophecy, and the 1844 development. Includes Q&A guide.
objectives: Explain the biblical basis in Daniel 7-9
Show the Day of Atonement typology

educator_resources.title: Aaron's Ministry Role Play
educator_resources.desc: Interactive dramatic presentation of the Day of Atonement service (Leviticus 16), connecting each step to Christ's heavenly ministry. Memorable and engaging for all ages.
objectives: Visualize the Day of Atonement service
Connect the earthly type to Christ's heavenly antitype

educator_resources.title: Sanctuary Furnishings Worksheet Set
educator_resources.desc: A complete set of fill-in-the-blank worksheets covering all seven sanctuary furnishings, their materials, location, and symbolic meaning. KJV scripture references included.
objectives: Identify their location (court, holy, most holy)
State the primary symbolic meaning of each

educator_resources.title: Daniel 8:14 Timeline Study
educator_resources.desc: Step-by-step study of Daniel 8 and 9, walking through the 2300-day prophecy, the 70-week cut-off, the 457 BC starting point, and the 1844 terminus. Includes Greek and Hebrew word studies.

educator_resources.title: Sacred Colors Scripture Matching Game
educator_resources.desc: Card-matching game where students match each sanctuary color to its biblical meaning, Hebrew name, and key scripture verse. Can be played individually or in teams.
objectives: Memorize the 8 sacred colors and meanings

educator_resources.title: Heavenly Sanctuary Discussion Guide
educator_resources.desc: Structured discussion guide for small groups exploring the reality of the heavenly sanctuary in Hebrews, the nature of Christ's high priestly ministry, and its practical implications for Christian living.
objectives: Establish the biblical reality of the heavenly sanctuary
Understand Christ's ongoing high priestly work
Apply sanctuary truth to daily Christian experience

educator_resources.title: Comparison Chart: Earthly vs Heavenly Sanctuary
educator_resources.desc: Detailed comparison chart contrasting the earthly sanctuary with the heavenly, the Levitical priesthood with Christ's Melchizedek priesthood, and the old covenant with the new. Based on the book of Hebrews.
objectives: See the inadequacy of the earthly system and its fulfillment in Christ
